notes.title: Unformed v.0.12 Update log
Cimugames releases “Unformed” at 72% off for Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Dear players who want to enrich their game library during the summer sale, we are Bones Studio, the production team behind the game ”Unformed". It’s that time the annual Steam summer sale. Due to a mistake we made while operating on Steam’s backend, "Unformed" unexpectedly joined the discount game army and went on sale at a discount of 72% off.

Why such an error, you ask? We set a game discount which was mis-applied to all games released by Cimugames, leading to a discount of "Unformed" and our other acclaimed game "Runestone Keeper” at 72% off the total price. Although such a big discount on "Unformed", which has only been in the EA stage for two months, was completely out of our plan, we finally decided not to revoke our summer sales promotion. We hope that players who have added the game to their wish list will still purchase the EA version to support our development. Of course, we invite everyone to take a look at our previous Roguelike game, "Runestone Keeper ", which is also currently undergoing a big sale.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/339400/Runestone_Keeper/

Next, we will share some of our work progress and the current status of the studio.

During our two months of silence, we’ve been working extensively and intensively to create new levels and optimize game sound effects and the feeling of impact when fighting. We have originally produced an interesting development log to illustrate all this, but since the multilingual version has not been completed, we have to disclose some in this announcement in advance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36598626/8518ba6410a155cb8bcb4f1d610127322bd6d174.png[/img]
This is a panoramic view of the level we are making. Maybe there will be some changes before the official launch, but the framework of the entire level is generally like this. The codename of this level is "Forgotten Palace", which is the most complicated level in the game so far, and it is also the climax of the story. We have completed the construction of this level and the design of the corresponding monsters, but we still need time to optimize the details.
At the same time, we are optimizing the impact feeling when fighting, battle sequences and sound effects of the game, so that players can get a better game experience. However, we have encountered a great deal of trouble in terms of sound effects, which is one of the reasons that we have been unable to release the update. As for the impact feeling, we have completed the modification. If we can't solve the sound effect problem quickly, we may consider putting some of the updates we have done into a test branch to show the player in advance.

Finally, we regret to announce something without cause for cheer.

We released the EA version of “Unformed" two months ago in order to hear and take to heart the opinions of players during the development and get a part of the income to maintain the studio's expenditure. However, due to the unsatisfactory sales of the EA version, Bones Studio's funds have been seriously insufficient. Although this does not stagger our resolve to continue the game, our members have had to leave us to find new jobs because of financial problems. The studio inevitably fell into a state of slow development. We are now working hard to solve the funding problem and looking for new partners. If you are interested in game development, we welcome everyone to participate in our production in various ways.

That's all for this announcement. We will send out the completed multi-language version of development log in the next announcement, then you will know more about our new level.

The Discord of our player group is: 983589205. Please feel free to join the group discussion.
We really appreciate your reviews and feedback. We welcome all of your comments and ask that you them leave them in the community or in the Discord channel: https://discord.gg/QJsnkM

We wish you all a happy and safe summer and a great time at the Steam summer sale finding your favorite wallpapers and backgrounds!

We love you all! 

Sincerely,
Bones Studio

notes.title: Unformed Patch Note V0.11 and following plan
notes.content:
Dear all players:

    After staying up for days, we made Users' Interfaces in our game much more player-friendly and reliable. That's the reason that we've been a little bit quite these days, and we are sorry for that. However, we read and talk about every single feedback from you and fix corresponding problems. Hope you can still stick with us.

Patch Note V0.11:
- fixed plenty of problems with stuck UI

- now UI hints support custom key settings

- completed translation of English texts in game

- added some basic tutorial based on [b]default key settings[/b]

- fixed collider  issues in scene (mostly in Sewer stage)

- improved the animation of Odachi's parry, now its hitbox and effective time is much clearer

Following plan:
- keep balancing & improving the animations of players and weapons

- balance the performance of enemies and bosses

- improving feedback of attack (long-term task)

- improving stage design, add some depth of field and perspective (long-term task)


We are also developing our new stage [b]Abandoned Palace[/b]. We will publish some images/video about it at a proper time. Thanks for your waiting!

30/04/2020
Bones Studio

notes.title: Unformed Patch Note V0.1 and following optimization plan
notes.content:
After releasing [i]Unformed[/i], we've received plenty of reviews and feedback. We are grateful for your attention and playing, and we are trying our best optimizing our game into a satisfying level.

Bones Studio is a freshmen team,  and we found out that we did miss some details subconsciously during our developing. We are sorry for the trouble caused by our negligence, and we now are working on making [i]Unformed[/i] more friendly to all the players. Thanks for your patience and waiting!

Patch Note V0.1:
- We fixed bugs of custom key settings, and clarified some interact texts.
- But still, we suggest players check key settings before playing, we will put some guidance at the 
  beginning soon. 

Following things are tasks that we are working on:

Highest priority tasks:
- We are fixing all the users' interface to make them easier to understand. We apologize for not testing 
  those factors enough, but believe us, we will fix them soon.
- Adding more detailed guidelines and tutorial
- Operating prompt adaptable with different types of input device

Tasks in queue:
- rare animation stuck
- collide mistakes
- rescale & balance of character's skills
- balancing weapons' performance
- adding more music and sound effects

We really do appreciate your reviews and feedback, please feel free to leave comments in community or in Discord channel! 

Discord:
https://discord.gg/QJsnkM

Sincerely 
Bones Studio

notes.title: “Unformed” Official Release Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players, having gone through years of producing and postponing, we’re finally ready to announce that Unformed has released its Early Access version. We hope you all have fun with it!

[b]Existing Content[/b]
We now have 3 levels and corresponding Bosses, 3 kinds of weapons and corresponding Combat skills, as well as part of the story. But of course, we’re keeping quiet about the plot! 

[b]Recent Update Plan[/b]
We will release the fourth level of the game as quickly as possible: Abandoned Palace. Chock full of all kinds of tricks, the Abandoned Palace is more like a huge maze in which players confront enemies who are ready to deliver fatal blows. With a considerable size, this level will be the difficulty watershed. We’ve finished the fundamental design and production, but it still needs polishing to meet our standards. Additionally, in order to help players understand and better explore the world by the given information from non-player characters, we will finish the NPC system in the near future.

[b]Possible Bugs[/b]
We have to admit that players may run into some occasional bugs, and here we would like to apologize in advance for the inconvenience. So far, problems seem to occur more often in the collision and monsters-respawn systems. We really appreciate for your understanding and patience for this and we will spare no expense to solve these problems. We would be grateful it if you could let us know the bugs you have met from Steam community or discord. It’s great encouragement to us when we can hear your voice. 

Discord channel: https://discord.gg/Z8pJ3R

[b]Pricing[/b]
The current price is for the Early Access version. If everything goes well, the officially released Unformed will contain 2 to 3 times the amount of content as the present version, and the system will also go through major improvements (within the development plan). Considering the cost, we may raise the price to 20% to 30%. Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: one-week extension for Unformed EA release date
notes.content:
Dear all players：

For making up the unexpected delay, we will hand out some copies of our game recently by our publisher. Again, please allow us to apologize for the extension, and we really hope Unformed can reach your expectations. 

Sincerely
Bones Studio
15/04/2020

notes.content:
Greetings players, we are Bones Studio. We really do apologize for being late, and we finally published our trailer on our steam page! Hope you can enjoy it! Meanwhile we will start the alpha test pretty soon, so please be patient for just a little while.

The Early Access version of Unformed will be publish on 17th April! We really wish you would enjoy and support our game!

If you have any questions or advise, please feel free to leave comments on our community page. We will try to reply as soon as possible.

notes.title: Extension of EA version's release date
notes.content:
Dear players:
[h1][/h1]Greetings and happy Chinese New Year. We are Bones Studio, the team who designed [i]Unformed[/i], and we appreciate your waiting for our Early Access version. However, we have to announce that due to the 2019-nCov's spreading circumstance, we will extend our release date to April 17th, 2020. We sincerely apologize for the delay, and we are grateful for your understanding. 
[h2][/h2]Our studio locate in Hangzhou, China. According to the policies of our local government, we are not allowed to restart working until 20th, Feb. Besides, one member of our team now is trapped in Wuhan, China, where the 2019-nCov starts. In this case, we are not able to make any progress of our game, [i]Unformed[/i]. Thus, we have to delay the release date in order to guarantee the quality of [i]Unformed[/i] reaches our standard and target.
[h3][/h3]Again, please accept our deepest apology, and meanwhile we wish all the players around the world could stay healthy, and keep away from the intrusion by disease. When spring comes, hope will arrive. 

Bones
02/19/2020
